dimensions.assessment: Aims to educate the general public, international allies, and victims of transnational repression, while assisting federal, state, local, Tribal, and territorial law enforcement officials.
dimensions.evidence: conduct a public service announcement campaign educating the public and international allies on the issue of transnational repression

dimensions.assessment: Mandates an educational public awareness campaign and technological research and development without altering criminal statutes or regulatory compliance mandates.
dimensions.evidence: carry out research and development, including operational testing, of technologies and techniques for enhancing the Department's support

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not specify appropriations or costs for the public service announcement campaign or research activities.
Amends the Homeland Security Act of 2002 to add a new section requiring specific public awareness and research mandates.
dimensions.evidence: Subtitle H of title VIII of the Homeland Security Act of 2002... is amended by adding at the end the following new section

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent statutory directives for the Department of Homeland Security, with a 1-year deadline for initiating research.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than one year after the date of the enactment of this section, the Secretary... shall... carry out research and development

missing_information: Specific funding amounts allocated for the public service announcement campaign and R&D
importance_detail.rationale: Directs the Department of Homeland Security to conduct a public service announcement campaign regarding transnational repression and terrorism threats, and to carry out research and development on support technologies for law enforcement.
